title: Fabric capture loss record / heartbeat v1 (draft, spec 047 rev 5, spec 048)
description: JSON form of a fabric.capture_loss or fabric.capture_heartbeat span. A loss names a range of a source's exchange sequences that will never produce an exchange span; a heartbeat declares the last exchange sequence the source has allocated, which is how tail loss becomes detectable. heartbeat_kind says why it was written: periodic, run_start / run_end (a fabric.wire.run() block, with run_id) or final (a clean close; nothing is allocated in the epoch after it). A retried export re-sends the same logical record; readers deduplicate heartbeats by (source, kind, run_id, scope_id, last_sequence). Run markers carry the scope_id of the fabric.wire.run() block entry they bound (spec 048 §6); readers pair markers by scope_id. Records do not consume sequences and carry no content. Loss records only explain gaps: a sequence that is neither an exchange nor inside a loss range is still a detected gap.

run_id.description: The run a run_start / run_end marker bounds. Capture writes it on markers only; readers treat a marker without run_id as an unclassified heartbeat and ignore run_id on periodic and final heartbeats.

scope_id.description: fabric.run.scope_id of the fabric.wire.run() block entry this run_start / run_end marker bounds (spec 048 §6). Only on run markers; a marker without a valid scope_id is an unclassified heartbeat.
